# E0336: a _match is not _match(source path, arms)

match takes two arguments: a reference into the source instance, and its
arms, a struct of `value: value` entries with an optional `[_]` catch-all.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	kind: "a" | "b"
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	kind: 1 | 2
}

ForwardLens: (prev): {
	self: {
		kind: _match(prev.kind)
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	kind: 1 | 2
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0336]: _match takes two arguments: _match(prev.<path>, {...})
 --> history/1.0.thema:7:9
  |
7 |         kind: _match(prev.kind)
  |               ^^^^^^
  |
```
